en: Black‑and‑white street view of a mid‑20th‑century town. In the foreground is a brick corner building with signage for Skandinaviska Banken, pedestrians on the sidewalks, and a car driving toward the camera. The street continues into the distance with shops and older buildings on the right, trees and a small park area further ahead, and a few people walking and cycling. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.
